summary_brief: 今日 AI 编程助手领域呈现三大核心趋势：多项目同步强化推理规划能力，技能系统标准化生态加速成型，多模型支持与互操作性成为关键竞争力。Codex、OpenCode、gptme 等项目集体推动 Plan Mode、Personality 系统和技能模块化架构演进，同时 Fabric 率先集成 Claude 4.0 模型与 1M 上下文窗口支持，标志着 AI 代码生成工具向更智能、更可组合的方向快速发展。

engineering_signals.title: AI 编程助手集体强化规划推理能力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex、OpenCode、gptme 和 Continue 等多个项目同步推出或优化 Plan Mode 功能，通过显式的任务规划步骤和响应约束规则，显著提升 AI 代理在复杂多步骤任务中的执行成功率和可控性。这标志着 AI 编程助手从即时响应模式向深思熟虑的规划模式演进。

engineering_signals.title: 技能系统标准化与模块化生态加速成型
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 和 OpenCode 正在推动技能加载路径统一化（.agents/skills/），建立标准化的技能调用遥测机制，并与独立的 openai/skills 公共仓库同步，体现了 AI 代理能力正在向可复用、可组合的插件系统演进，为构建开放生态奠定基础。

engineering_signals.title: 多模型互操作性与 Claude 4.0 集成浪潮
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Fabric 率先集成 Claude Sonnet 4.0 和 Opus 4.0 模型并支持 1M 上下文窗口，OpenCode 修复 Anthropic 和 Gemini 模型切换边界情况，显示多模型支持和跨平台兼容性已成为 AI 编程工具的核心竞争力。同时 Claude Code Action v1.0 正式发布，标志着 AI 助手在 CI/CD 流程中达到生产就绪状态。

engineering_signals.title: Personality 系统生产化与交互体验优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 将 Personality API 从实验性升级为稳定版本，默认切换为 Friendly 模式，并引入完整的迁移框架确保向后兼容，同时添加验证测试保证用户体验一致性。这表明 AI 编码助手的人机交互体验正在从功能可用性向体验友好性和生产稳定性转变。

engineering_signals.title: 跨平台兼容性与性能优化集中发力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 今日多个项目集中解决跨平台问题：Codex 的 UTF-8 支持转正、Nix flake 更新适配 Rust 1.91+、Zed 编辑器修复大规模 Git 命令失败和光标位置预测、Anthropic SDK 修复 AbortSignal 内存泄漏。这些优化体现了 AI 编程工具在不同操作系统和开发环境下对稳定性和性能的持续投入。

engineering_signals.title: 可观测性增强：遥测与日志优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入 WebSocket 遥测指标并在历史 UI 中展示，gptme 优化日志详度分级（每条消息 DEBUG 级别，摘要 INFO 级别），显示 AI 编程工具正在加强运行时监控和调试能力，为生产环境部署提供更好的可观测性保障。

engineering_signals.title: SDK 依赖升级与安全维护同步推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目（Langchain、Continue、Fabric）集中升级 AWS SDK、Anthropic SDK 和 Urllib3 等核心依赖，修复已知安全漏洞并确保与最新模型 API 的兼容性。这种跨项目的依赖升级反映了生态系统的安全意识和技术债务管理实践。

releases.summary:
# 🎉 Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0 - Now Generally Available!

We're excited to announce the v1.0 release of Claude Code GitHub Action! This major release brings significant improvements in simplicity, flexibility, and power to AI-assisted development workflows.

## 🚀 What's New in v1.0

### Simplified Configuration
- **Automatic mode detection** - No more manual `mode` configuration. The action intelligently determines whether to run in interactive or automation mode based on your setup
- **Unified interface** - All prompts now go through a single `prompt` input, and all CLI options through `claude_args`
- **Better SDK alignment** - Closer integration with the Claude Code CLI for a consistent experience

### More Powerful & Flexible
- Direct access to all Claude Code CLI capabilities through `claude_args`
- Support for custom system prompts, tool configurations, and model selection
- Enhanced compatibility with AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

This release includes breaking changes from v0.x. Key deprecated inputs have been replaced with a cleaner, more intuitive API:
- `mode`, `direct_prompt`, `override_prompt` → unified `prompt` input
- `custom_instructions`, `model`, `allowed_tools`, `mcp_config` → `claude_args` with CLI format
- Other deprecated: `disallowed_tools`, `anthropic_model`, `trigger_phrase`, `timeout_minutes`

**📚 Please review our [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) for detailed upgrade instructions and examples.**

## 💡 New Use Cases & Examples

Explore the expanded possibilities with v1.0! We've created comprehensive examples showcasing various workflows:

- **Automated PR Reviews** - Intelligent code review on every pull request
- **CI Failure Fixes** - Automatically diagnose and fix failing tests
- **Issue Triage** - Smart categorization and response to new issues
- **Documentation Generation** - Keep docs in sync with code changes
- **Security Scanning** - Proactive vulnerability detection
- **And many more!**

**🔧 Check out all examples at [github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples)**

## 🏃 Quick Start

```yaml
# Interactive mode - responds to @claude mentions
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

# Automation mode - runs immediately with prompt
- uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
  with:
    prompt: "Review this PR for security issues"
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    claude_args: |
      --model claude-4-0-sonnet-20250805
      --max-turns 10
```

## 📖 Resources

- [Migration Guide](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.md) - Step-by-step upgrade instructions
- [Examples](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples) - Ready-to-use workflow templates
- [Documentation](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action#readme) - Complete setup and configuration guide

## 🙏 Thank You

Thank you to our beta users for your invaluable feedback that shaped this release. We're excited to see what you'll build with Claude Code GitHub Action v1.0!

key_changes: 统一配置接口 - 自动模式检测，无需手动配置 mode 参数
所有输入整合为 prompt 和 claude_args 两个参数，简化配置
Breaking Changes - 多个旧参数被废弃，包括 mode、direct_prompt、custom_instructions 等
完整支持 Claude Code CLI 功能，兼容 AWS Bedrock 和 Google Vertex AI
新增多个实用场景示例：PR 审查、CI 失败修复、问题分类、文档生成
ai_summary.summary_cn: Claude Code GitHub Action 发布 v1.0 主版本，带来重大架构升级。配置方式全面简化为统一的 prompt 和 claude_args 参数，但包含多个破坏性变更，需要参考迁移指南升级。新版本提供更强大的 CLI 集成能力和丰富的自动化工作流示例，支持 PR 审查、CI 修复等多种场景。
